title: 36 Of the qualities and conditions of thoſe which they ought to elect.

segments.text: AS concernynge the conditions requyred in thoſe whiche ſhoulde be elected and choſen, it is manyfeſtlye declared at large by the ſpyrite and worde of God. Wherefore we maye conclude that hee which wyll dyſpence with any for money or rewardes cannot be led but with the ſpirite of Sathan.
